title: Exquisite Wormhole
description: Are your legs too weak to walk a thousand blocks? The Wormhole Potion adds an easy way to teleport to your friends.
body:
**Exquisite Wormhole: Terraria-style Teleportation**
Wormhole brings a familiar and highly requested mechanic from Terraria straight into Minecraft. If you've ever felt that traveling to your friends takes too much time, this mod is the perfect solution for your multiplayer adventures!

**Key Features:**
Wormhole Potions: A new consumable item that allows for teleportation between players.
Intuitive UI: Simply use right-click potion to open a user-friendly interface showing all online players. Click a name, and you're there!
Vanilla-Friendly Crafting: No overpowered cheats. The potion is integrated into the vanilla brewing system, making it feel like a natural part of the game.

**How to get started:**
Brewing: Place an Ender Pearl into a Brewing Stand with an Awkward Potion.
Teleporting: Ensure the player you want to teleport to is online.
Usage: Use the potion, select your friend from the list, and bridge the distance in a second!

**Enhance your Multiplayer Experience:**
This mod is designed specifically for SMP and Co-op play. It removes the tediousness of long treks while maintaining game balance through the brewing cost. Perfect for large maps or modpacks where players are spread far apart.
